name: Boot milestone log (task main init calls and I2C transfers, into the monitor log ring)
about: Apply together with debug-monitor.json. Logs one text line per init call of `task main` (b01..b11) and one per I2C transfer made during init (address, direction, status) into the debug monitor's RAM log ring; read it with `hl mon log`. RAM only, no flash writes. Uses the second half of the monitor's cave page and reserves 16 bytes of heap RAM. Source openhuilian/patch/cave/bootlog.c, built by openhuilian/patch/cave/build_bootlog.py; checked in openhuilian/emu/bootlog_check.py. See docs/research/boot-log.md.
